title: Google WeatherNext 3 Moves AI Forecasts Into Products
summary: The new global model produces hourly forecasts from satellite and station data and will feed Search, Maps, Gemini and cloud services.
body:
## Hourly global forecasting

Google DeepMind and Google Research have introduced WeatherNext 3, a global AI weather model designed to produce a new forecast every hour rather than waiting for the six-hour update cycle common to traditional global systems. Google is integrating its output into Search, Gemini, Maps, Google Maps Platform and Earth Engine, with operational and historical data also available through BigQuery and Cloud Storage.

The model works directly with raw satellite imagery and weather-station observations. Google says this lets it respond more quickly to changing rain and snow patterns while representing local conditions that can be poorly covered by conventional observation networks. WeatherNext 3 predicts station-targeted temperature and humidity at five-kilometer resolution and other surface variables, including wind, at ten kilometers.

Its design also targets commercial forecasting. Outputs include cloud cover and solar radiation relevant to renewable-energy operators, while hourly forecast initialization could help logistics, agriculture and utilities react to rapidly developing conditions. Google says the model improves precipitation detail and boundary definition, two areas where probabilistic AI forecasts have often appeared blurred.

## Deployment at consumer scale

The most important change is operational rather than purely experimental. Google plans to place the model behind products used by billions of people, creating a direct route from AI meteorology research to everyday decisions. Developers and organizations can access the same forecast family without installing or maintaining the model themselves.

Google cautions that WeatherNext remains an input to decision-making, not a replacement for official warnings from national and local meteorological agencies. Public evidence is also still dominated by Google’s own evaluation, so performance across rare events, poorly observed regions and different forecast horizons will need independent examination.

## Why it matters

Weather forecasting is a consequential test of AI outside conversational products: predictions can be scored against physical reality and carry direct economic and safety effects. Hourly global updates combined with mass-market distribution could make WeatherNext 3 one of the most widely used scientific AI systems, provided its local accuracy holds up in live operations.
title_zh: 谷歌 WeatherNext 3 将 AI 天气预报接入核心产品
summary_zh: 新模型结合卫星与气象站数据，每小时生成全球预报，并将进入搜索、地图、Gemini 和谷歌云服务。
body_zh:
## 全球预报进入每小时更新

Google DeepMind 与 Google Research 发布 WeatherNext 3。这套全球 AI 天气模型可以每小时启动一次新预报，突破传统全球系统常见的六小时更新周期。谷歌将把结果接入搜索、Gemini、地图、Google Maps Platform 和 Earth Engine，并通过 BigQuery 与 Cloud Storage 提供实时及历史数据。

模型直接处理原始卫星影像和气象站观测。谷歌称，这种方式能更快捕捉雨雪变化，也有助于刻画传统观测网络覆盖不足地区的局地气候。WeatherNext 3 可在五公里分辨率上预测面向气象站的温度与湿度，并在十公里分辨率上预测风等其他地表变量。

它还明确面向商业预报场景，输出可再生能源运营所需的云量、太阳辐射等变量。更频繁的预报启动，也可能帮助物流、农业和公用事业应对快速发展的天气。谷歌表示，新模型改善了降水细节及天气边界的呈现，针对的是概率式 AI 预报过去容易模糊的环节。

## 从研究成果走向大规模部署

这次更新的核心不只是实验指标，而是投入实际产品。谷歌计划把模型放到数十亿人使用的服务背后，为 AI 气象研究建立直达日常决策的分发渠道。开发者和企业也能直接调用同一预报体系，无需自行部署和维护模型。

谷歌同时提醒，WeatherNext 只能作为决策参考，不能替代国家或地方气象机构发布的正式预警。目前公开证据仍以谷歌自身评测为主，其在罕见灾害、观测稀疏地区及不同预报时长上的表现仍需独立验证。

## 为何重要

天气预报是检验 AI 能否走出聊天产品的高价值场景：预测会被真实物理世界直接检验，并影响安全和经济活动。如果局地精度经得起实际运行，按小时更新并接入大众产品的 WeatherNext 3，可能成为覆盖面最广的科学 AI 系统之一。

sources.title: Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model

cat_take_en: Hourly refreshes delivered through Maps matter more than another laboratory accuracy record.
